purpose: Agent-maintained screen inventory supporting the concise human report in test-plan.md. Update affected entries when routes or meaningful coverage change; no per-edit hash maintenance.

browserVerification.scope: 28 routed screen variants and /orders redirect observed; not all states, roles or primary workflows verified.

countingRule: Count routed screen variants, including create/edit and inventory list/inspector separately. Exclude redirects and embedded sections from the screen denominator.

coverageLevels.partial: Meaningful screen assertions exist; functional coverage remains incomplete.
coverageLevels.navigation: Arrival, root or heading assertions only.
